spans.s:
The affix क्विप्‌ comes after the verb सु 'to press out juice' with the sense of past time, when the word सोम , in the Accusative -2nd case, is in composition.

Terms: क्विप्‌

The affix ट्यण् comes after the name सोम in the sense of 'this its deity'.

Terms: ट्यण्

The affix य comes in the sense of 'who deserves that' after the word सोम in the Accusative -2nd case in construction, in the छन्दस् (Vedas).

Terms: य

ह्वरित् is irregularly formed from ह्वृ in the छन्दस् (Vedas) by गुण substitution and इट् augment when it refers to सोम।

Terms: इट् augment
